Everything with LSN ≤ checkpoint_lsn is already
folded into the image (the checkpoint truncated
the WAL to the committed watermark), so replay
only needs the durable tail past checkpoint_lsn.
(dense CX snapshot ⇒ the base in-memory trie)
stopping at the first torn / un-fsync'd frame
(CRC mismatch or short read ⇒ end of durable prefix)
per term, was the last writer's record
the term to its last committed value
no caller ever saw it succeed
